4186-4279-6752.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
4186-4279-6752.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Haliya and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Haliya and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3899-4419-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
3899-4419-4694-7306.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

240-728-1115-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-1115-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2457-5794-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating six 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1545-3179-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Trostani trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1545-3179-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2506-4600-4772-7150.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3836-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2511-4681-5170-6794.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

57-2341-4846-6633.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
Feldon is not your commander.
57-2341-4846-6633.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2478-2866-4986.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-4316-5220--53.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature that can be cast using {C}{C}, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
2034-4316-5220--53.notes: If the creature can be cast using {C} or less, the combo nets infinite colorless mana.

1545-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1545-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the creature's toughness.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.
1545-5670-6792--5.notes: This combo results in infinite lifegain if the creature has 2 or more toughness once its returned to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

2341-4659-6591.easyPrerequisites:
Squall is not your commander.
You have a permanent card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
2341-4659-6591.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Squall's ability.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing The Peregrine Dynamo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Peregrine Dynamo ability, copying Squall's trigger, with the new trigger targeting The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Squall's trigger, returning The Peregrine Dynamo from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3240-5256-6462-6560.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anafenza triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Spirit.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1432-2872--80.notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
There is another legendary creature on the battlefield.
1432-2872--80.description:
If Clever Conjurer is not your Ring-bearer, use the card that causes the Ring to tempt you to cause Clever Conjurer to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer and another legendary creature.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat from step 2.

3043-4824-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two creatures with defender.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
3043-4824-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Axebane Guardian's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2691-5149-5200.easyPrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Sword of the Paruns.
2691-5149-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Ilysian Caryatid does not have summoning sickness. You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Ilysian Caryatid
2691-5149-5200.description:
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Ilysian Caryatid.
Repeat.
2691-5149-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

654-1993-3756-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Budoka Gardener.
Budoka Gardener does not have summoning sickness.
You control eight or less lands.
654-1993-3756-4222.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat.

2178-4319-4424-5147.notablePrerequisites:
You control another nontoken nonartifact creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Skirk Alarmist.
2178-4319-4424-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nontoken nonartifact creature.
When the creature dies, Missy's first ability and Skirk Alarmist trigger.
Resolve the Missy ability, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Skirk Alarmist trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning the creature face up.
Repeat.

2440-3480-3952-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Phoenix.
2440-3480-3952-5231.description:
Activate Purphoros by paying {2}{R}, putting Firestorm Phoenix onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Firestorm Phoenix enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Firestorm Phoenix, adding {R}.
Firestorm Phoenix is returned to your hand instead of being put into your graveyard.
Repeat.
If there are at least two other Phoenixs on the battlefield, this combo will produce infinite colorless mana.

1339-1636-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zimone and Dina.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-1636-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeating the process one additional time if you control at least eight lands.
The Locust God triggers for each card drawn this way, creating at least one 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.
When the Insect(s) enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers that many times, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2011-3000-3049-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Najeela and Sophina do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other nontoken creatures that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
2011-3000-3049-4050.description:
Declare Najeela, Sophina, and at least three other nontoken creatures as attackers.
Sophina and Najeela trigger.
Resolve the Sophina trigger, creating at least five 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens and five Clue tokens.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five creature tokens, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

914-2815-5220-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure.
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2815-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Mortuary, causing you to put Dockside Extortionist on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dockside Extortionist's power.
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, exiling Dockside Extortionist from the top of your library and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Cast Dockside Extortionist from exile by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

971-4629-5017.notablePrerequisites:
Pentad Prism has at least one charge counter.
Urban Daggertooth has at least one +1/+1 counter.
You have the highest life total.
971-4629-5017.description:
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Urban Daggertooth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Urban Daggertooth and a charge counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism's ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

186-411-913-2510.notablePrerequisites: Any creature exiled by Semblance Anvil.
186-411-913-2510.description:
Pay {R} to return Grinning Ignus to your hand, adding {R}{C}{C}.
Cast Grinning Ignus for {R}.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow for {C} to add {R} leaving you where you started with with an additional {1}.
Repeat for infinite mana.
